overview.about: Bad Bunny is the most-streamed Latin artist in the world, and his stadium and arena shows are among the hottest tickets in music. This entry marks his Madrid night on a world tour that blends reggaeton, Latin trap and Puerto Rican rhythms into a high-energy production for a sold-out Spanish crowd.
overview.nextEvent: Individual tour nights are one-off shows; check the artist's official channels for any future Madrid dates. Bad Bunny's tours routinely sell out arenas and stadiums across Europe, Latin America and North America.
